en_title: Sony Squeezes in Last-Minute PS5 Firmware Security Update Ahead of GTA 6 Release Date, Amid Fresh Hacker Claim
cn_title: 在黑客提出新说法之际，索尼赶在《GTA6》发售日期前最后时刻推出PS5固件安全更新
opus_summary: 索尼在《GTA6》发售前一天发布PS5系统软件更新14.23，官方称其修复了部分安全问题。此前，一名黑客声称已在14.22版本上提取游戏二进制文件。目前没有证据表明此次更新是对此事的回应，也未确认游玩《GTA6》是否需要更新至14.23。

paragraphs.en: Sony has released a new PS5 firmware security update just a day before the release of GTA 6 , and hot on the heels of a new claim from a prominent hacker around the console.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼在《GTA6》发售仅一天前发布了一项新的PS5固件安全更新，就在此前不久，一名知名黑客刚刚针对这款主机提出了一项新说法。

paragraphs.en: PS5 system software update 26.07-14.23.00 is available now, weighing in at 1.267 GB, and according to Sony’s official patch notes , it makes “some security fixes to the system software.”
paragraphs.cn: PS5系统软件更新26.07-14.23.00现已推出，大小为1.267 GB。根据索尼的官方更新说明，该更新「对系统软件进行了一些安全修复」。

paragraphs.en: Today’s update comes just two weeks after PS5 firmware update 26.07-14.22.00 came out , which itself was released just 11 days after the release of 14.20.
paragraphs.cn: 今天的更新距离PS5固件更新26.07-14.22.00推出仅两周，而后者是在14.20发布仅11天后推出的。

paragraphs.en: The PlayStation homebrew scene has made headlines in the last two months for releasing PS5 jailbreaks for prior firmwares. For example, late September, a jailbreak that supported all PS5 consoles running firmware 7.00-13.60 sent shockwaves through the homebrew community because, at the time, it meant that all PS5s, including the PS5 Pro, that hadn't been updated within the previous week were compatible with the jailbreak. This was of huge significance for Sony and the security of the PS5, as people with a jailbroken PS5 can modify their console, potentially opening the door to video game piracy.
paragraphs.cn: 过去两个月，PlayStation自制软件社区因发布针对旧版固件的PS5越狱工具而登上新闻头条。例如，9月下旬，一款支持所有运行7.00至13.60固件的PS5主机的越狱工具在自制软件社区引发巨大震动，因为在当时，这意味着所有在前一周内没有更新过的PS5，包括PS5 Pro，都与该越狱工具兼容。这对索尼和PS5的安全具有重大影响，因为拥有已越狱PS5的人可以修改自己的主机，这可能为电子游戏盗版打开大门。

paragraphs.en: However, it was found that some PS5 games subsequently required the more recent 14.00 firmware in order to download updates, sparking a renewed effort to release a new jailbreak for the updated system software. So, there is a game of Whac-A-Mole at play where the homebrew scene is working to release a new jailbreak for the latest PS5 firmware, then do it all over again when Sony releases a new firmware update designed to beef up security.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，人们发现，一些PS5游戏随后要求使用较新的14.00固件才能下载更新，这促使人们重新努力为更新后的系统软件发布新的越狱工具。因此，一场打地鼠游戏正在上演：自制软件社区努力为最新的PS5固件发布新的越狱工具，然后在索尼推出旨在加强安全性的新固件更新时再从头来过。

paragraphs.en: This in turn has sparked concern that if a PS5 jailbreak was made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6, then it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and maybe even made available on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 这又引发了人们的担忧：如果出现适用于《GTA6》所需固件的PS5越狱工具，那么Rockstar的这款游戏可能会在PS5上遭到盗版，甚至可能被搬到PC上。

paragraphs.en: 14.23 released today just a day after a prominent PS5 hacker claimed to be the first person to have “dumped” a game binary at 14.22. While this wasn’t necessarily evidence of a full jailbreak for PS5 on that firmware, it did send the homebrew community into speculation overdrive on whether Sony would react quickly.
paragraphs.cn: 14.23于今天发布，就在一天前，一名知名PS5黑客声称自己是第一个在14.22固件上「转储」游戏二进制文件的人。虽然这未必能证明该固件上的PS5已被完全越狱，但确实让自制软件社区对索尼是否会迅速作出反应展开了大量猜测。

paragraphs.en: There’s no evidence to suggest this latest firmware update was in response to the latest development, and it is not yet confirmed whether 14.23 will be required to play GTA 6. But it’s hard not to view it as yet another attempt to close the circle ahead of GTA 6’s release.
paragraphs.cn: 没有证据表明这次最新固件更新是针对最新进展作出的回应，也尚未确认游玩《GTA6》是否需要14.23固件。但人们很难不将其视为索尼在《GTA6》发售前再次尝试堵住漏洞。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 preload launched last week, but Rockstar Games has continued to update it in recent days. The question for Sony is whether it can do enough to eventually win this game of Whac-A-Mole with the homebrew scene. This is something of an existential crisis for Sony, which publishers and developers rely upon for the security of their PlayStation releases. But with the emergence of powerful AI models, the stakes have risen significantly.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》上周开启了预载，但Rockstar最近几天仍在继续更新预载内容。索尼面临的问题是，它能否采取足够的措施，最终赢得这场与自制软件社区之间的打地鼠游戏。这对索尼而言在某种程度上是一场生存危机，发行商和开发商依靠索尼保障他们在PlayStation上发行的作品的安全。但随着强大的AI模型出现，事态的重要性显著上升。

paragraphs.en: Just last week, Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of Rockstar parent company Take-Two, told IGN that the company was taking security seriously , and insisted that fans will prefer to play GTA 6 officially, with all its bells and whistles as Rockstar intended, over an unofficial PC version.
paragraphs.cn: 就在上周，Rockstar母公司Take-Two的首席执行官Strauss Zelnick告诉IGN，公司正在认真对待安全问题。他还坚称，粉丝们会更愿意按照Rockstar的预期，通过官方渠道体验拥有全部丰富功能的《GTA6》，而不是游玩非官方PC版本。

paragraphs.en: During an investor-focused Q&A, Zelnick was asked multiple times about this AI reverse-engineering problem. He, again, had strong words in response, suggesting Take-Two was ready to lawyer up.
paragraphs.cn: 在一场面向投资者的问答会上，Zelnick多次被问及这一AI逆向工程问题。他再次以强硬措辞回应，暗示Take-Two已准备好寻求法律支持。

paragraphs.en: “This business has been largely immune to piracy concerns forever because of file sizes, complexity of piracy, being connected to servers and the like,” he began. “And undoubtedly, it would be very difficult to replicate the experience of consuming our game as intended because of technical limitations.
paragraphs.cn: 他首先表示：「由于文件大小、盗版的复杂性、需要连接服务器等原因，这个行业一直以来基本不受盗版问题的困扰。毫无疑问，由于技术限制，要复制按照预期体验我们游戏的感受将非常困难。」

paragraphs.en: “That said, it's going to become more of a challenge, as you said, and we're aware of that. So we are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defenses and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. And at the same time, without in any way being cavalier, every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy. So this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「话虽如此，正如你所说，这将变得更具挑战性，我们也意识到了这一点。因此，我们正全力加强技术防御，并适当地加强法律行动。与此同时，我绝不是在轻描淡写，但现存的每一家娱乐企业都在某种程度上受到盗版影响。因此，盗版很可能会或多或少地侵入我们的业务。我认为这将是可控的，我们正关注着这个问题。」

paragraphs.en: IGN reported on a hacker who had sparked an uproar within the PS5 homebrew scene for privately reporting an exploit to Sony and cashing in on a $50,000 reward, rather than keeping it confidential for the community.
paragraphs.cn: IGN曾报道过一名黑客，他因私下向索尼报告一个漏洞并领取50,000美元奖金，而不是为了社区对漏洞保密，在PS5自制软件社区引发轩然大波。
